name: Pillar Fist
description: Drive a fist down the straight line of the body with the other arm braced beside it as a pillar.

name: Pillar Brace
description: Stand with arms and legs set as pillars so that a blow passes down them into the ground.

name: Pillar Pace
description: Advance by pairs of heavy steps that keep both legs set as supports under the frame.

name: Pillar Hammer
description: Bring the paired fists down in turn like twin hammers on the same point of the target.

name: Limb Lock
description: Clamp the target between both arms and legs like a frame of pillars and hold it there.

name: Pillar Vigor
description: Run qi down the paired limbs of an ally by touch so each leg and arm bears more.

name: Pillar Return
description: Catch a blow on one pillar of the body and send it back down the other into the attacker.

name: Pillar Slam
description: Slam the whole upright frame into the target so it is knocked back and cannot rise quickly.

name: Pillar Sundering
description: Split the target's guard and frame with a blow set as a pillar's whole mass at the point of contact.

name: Felling Collapse
description: The school's great stroke in which the user falls forward as a toppling pillar and the whole mass lands on the target.

name: Judge Fist
description: Throw a measured fist that tests the guard before the second blow is thrown.

name: Judge Guard
description: Hold a level and calm guard that weighs every blow and gives it no ground.

name: Judge Pace
description: Advance at a slow and certain pace as if each step were a judgment already made.

name: Judge Press
description: Bear down on the target until it admits it cannot raise a hand against the user.

name: Judge Grip
description: Seize the target in a grip that is not let go until the exchange is decided.

name: Judge Vigor
description: Lend an ally calm and weighty strength by laying a steady hand on its shoulder.

name: Absolving Breath
description: Breathe out the guilt of strain and let clean qi wash poison or exhaustion from the user or an ally.

name: Judge Hammer
description: Pass sentence with a hammer blow that falls once and is meant to be final.

name: Judge Rebuke
description: Deny the target's strike and answer it with the sentence of a counter blow.

name: Judgment Fall
description: Bring both fists down from above in the court's final judgment so the target is struck and shaken.

name: Absolute Verdict
description: The school's final stroke in which the two fists pass one verdict upon the target that none of its strength can appeal.

name: Filled Sinewfist
description: Strike with a fist that has been filled like a basin and spills its weight on the mark.

name: Filled Framebrace
description: Hold the stance deep and level to take a blow and pour its force into the ground.

name: Filled Pace
description: Step with the weight low and full as water carried in a basin is carried.

name: Filled Brawndraw
description: Draw qi into the belly until the body is filled to the brim with ready strength.

name: Filled Hammer
description: Pour the stored weight of the frame into a hammer blow that spills over the guard.

name: Filled Press
description: Press down on the target with weight that rises steadily like water filling a basin.

name: Filled Rouse
description: Pour a measure of the user's stored qi into an ally to rouse its limbs to greater strength.

name: Filled Cleanse
description: Let the stored qi run clean through the user or an ally and carry out poison or taint.

name: Filled Flood
description: Spill the stored force outward in a flood that strikes every target around the user.

name: Filled Rebuke
description: Take the force of a blow into the stored reserve and return the whole of it in a counter.

name: Filled Cascade
description: Open the full basin at once so that a torrent of weight rushes out and flattens the front before the user.

name: Overflowing Might
description: The school's great stroke in which gathered force overflows every limit of the body and floods the whole front.

name: Duotrack Fist
description: Throw a fist along one track while the second track carries qi to the next blow.

name: Duotrack Guard
description: Hold two tracks of guard so that if one is struck the other still stands.

name: Duotrack Pace
description: Run the feet on two separate tracks so the body can change its line mid-stride.

name: Duotrack Hammer
description: Hammer along both tracks in the same breath so that two heavy blows land together.

name: Duotrack Press
description: Press the target from two directions at once so that no line of escape remains.

name: Duotrack Rouse
description: Run qi down both tracks of an ally's body so its guard and its strikes rise together.

name: Duotrack Ruin
description: Ruin the target's guard with two blows from two tracks that meet in the centre.

name: Duotrack Rebuke
description: Turn aside an attack on one track and return a heavy blow on the second.

name: Duotrack Colossus
description: Rise to the full height of a colossus on both tracks and bring it down on the target with a binding blow.

name: Twintrack Annihilation
description: The school's final stroke in which two tracks of giant force meet on one point and annihilate what stands there.

name: Apex Fist
description: Strike with a fist that carries the full height of the user's accumulated strength.

name: Apex Brace
description: Hold the highest stance of the school and let the body stand as one unmovable mass.

name: Apex Pace
description: Move with the controlled weight of a body that has grown past every ordinary limit.

name: Apex Hammer
description: Bring the full weight of a refined frame down in one hammer blow upon the guard.

name: Apex Press
description: Hold the target beneath a refined and heavy pressure that grows the longer it resists.

name: Apex Vigor
description: Share the Core's steady strength with an ally so its frame swells and its blows grow heavier.

name: Apex Cleanse
description: Pour refined qi from the Core through the user or an ally to burn out poison or backlash.

name: Apex Ruin
description: Ruin guard and footing with a blow whose weight has been refined to its highest degree.

name: Apex Rebuke
description: Meet a strike with the unmovable frame and return it through a counter of equal mass.

name: Apex Colossus
description: Stand as a colossus at the school's height and flatten the target with a single heavy fall.

name: Titan Ascendant
description: The school's great stroke in which the Core lifts the whole frame to its zenith and drives it down upon the front.

name: Vowed Fist
description: Throw a fist that has been vowed to the mark and does not drift from it.

name: Vowed Brawnguard
description: Hold the arms and legs fixed by a vow not to break before the blow is spent.

name: Vowed Pace
description: Advance at the pace of the vow and keep it whatever the target does.

name: Vowed Hammer
description: Bring the vowed fist down like a hammer that has sworn to meet its mark.

name: Vowed Press
description: Hold the target in place under the weight of a vow that does not weaken.

name: Vowed Brawnrise
description: Give an ally a share of the vow's steadiness so its strength rises and holds.

name: Vowed Ruin
description: Bring ruin upon the target's guard with a blow that keeps its vow to land.

name: Vowed Rebuke
description: Hold the vowed guard against a blow and return it by the same vowed line.

name: Vowed Colossus
description: Rise as a colossus held to its vow and bring it down upon the target in a binding stroke.

name: Vowfall
description: The school's great stroke in which the whole vow falls as one mass and none before it can stand.

name: Heldfast Fist
description: Strike with a fist that has held its weight a long time before it is let go.

name: Heldfast Brace
description: Hold the brace fast and let a blow spend itself against a body that will not move.

name: Heldfast Pace
description: Advance with the weight held and never rushed so that the stance is whole at every step.

name: Heldfast Hammer
description: Loose a hammer blow from a weight held far past the point where an ordinary fist would fall.

name: Heldfast Press
description: Hold the target under a pressure that does not slacken for as long as the stance lasts.

name: Heldfast Rouse
description: Rouse an ally to hold fast by lending it the user's own steadiness of body and qi.

name: Heldfast Breath
description: Hold a long breath and release it to carry poison or fear out of the user or an ally.

name: Heldfast Ruin
description: Ruin the target with a blow loosed only after the stance has held through a full exchange.

name: Heldfast Return
description: Hold fast against a strike and return it all at once in a single heavy stroke.

name: Heldfast Colossus
description: Loose the held mass of a colossus in one blow that drives the target to its knees.

name: Unrelenting Hold
description: The school's great stroke in which the weight is held without end and then loosed upon a bound target.

name: Bearing Knuckle
description: Strike along the long bearing so that the fist arrives with the weight of the whole stride.

name: Bearing Anchorage
description: Brace the body on the bearing and take the blow without leaving the line.

name: Bearing Footfall
description: Walk the bearing at a pace that tires neither the legs nor the line of attack.

name: Bearing Appraisal
description: Gauge the weight and direction of the force pressing the user and find the true bearing.

name: Bearing Shove
description: Shove along the bearing with the whole frame so the target is driven straight back.

name: Bearing Grip
description: Take a grip on the target's limb and hold it fixed along the line of the bearing.

name: Bearing Rouse
description: Rouse an ally along a shared bearing so its strength rises and does not flag.

name: Bearing Cleanse
description: Send clean qi along the bearing to clear poison or weariness from the user or an ally.

name: Bearing Ruin
description: Ruin the target's guard with a blow that has never left the bearing since the exchange began.

name: Bearing Return
description: Turn aside a blow along the bearing and return it with the weight of the whole stance.

name: Bearing Colossus
description: Come down as a colossus on the bearing and crush and hold the target in one stroke.

name: Unbroken Bearing
description: The school's final stroke which is the bearing held unbroken to the end and loosed as one blow.

name: Spread Fist
description: Strike with the arm opened wide so the fist travels through its full arc.

name: Spread Guard
description: Spread the arms and the qi around them so that blows from any side are met.

name: Spread Pace
description: Step wide with the whole frame open and the weight carried evenly across the stance.

name: Spread Hammer
description: Swing the open frame round in a wide hammering arc that sweeps the near ground.

name: Spread Press
description: Spread the weight of the field outward until it presses the target on every side.

name: Spread Rouse
description: Spread the user's qi field over a company of allies to lend each a share of strength.

name: Spread Ruin
description: Ruin the guard of every target in reach with a wide blow thrown from the open frame.

name: Spread Return
description: Meet an attack with the open guard and return the whole of it in a wide counter.

name: Spread Colossus
description: Stand open as a colossus and bring a wall-less weight down upon every target before the user.

name: Boundless Frame
description: The school's great stroke in which the open frame fills the whole field with a weight that has no edge.

name: Zenith Knuckle
description: Strike with a fist whose weight has been sworn to the height of the user's strength.

name: Zenith Frameguard
description: Hold the sworn stance at its height so that the frame is a single immovable mass.

name: Zenith Pace
description: Walk with the poise of a sworn titan whose every step lands where it was meant.

name: Zenith Hammer
description: Bring the sworn fist down like a hammer of fully refined weight.

name: Zenith Press
description: Press the target beneath the oath-held weight of the Core until it cannot resist.

name: Zenith Vigor
description: Share the Core's sworn strength with an ally so its frame rises to its fullest force.

name: Zenith Purgation
description: Pour the Core's sworn qi through the user or an ally to clear poison or backlash.

name: Zenith Ruin
description: Ruin the guard and stance of the target with a blow driven from the sworn height.

name: Zenith Rebuke
description: Stand sworn against a strike and return it in kind with the weight of the Core behind it.

name: Zenith Colossus
description: Stand as the sworn colossus at the height of the school and bind and crush the target.

name: Sworn Ascendant
description: The school's great stroke in which the Core and the oath lift the frame to its height and bring it down upon the front.
